name: CodeBuddy
description: Tencent Cloud's AI coding assistant powered by Hunyuan/DeepSeek models. Supports 200+ languages and mainstream IDEs. Available as IDE, plugin, and CLI. 120ms response latency (fastest in 2026 benchmarks). Supports MCP protocol. Used by 85%+ of Tencent internal developers. Free personal version; standard version ~99/month.

name: DevEco CodeGenie
description: Huawei's AI-assisted programming tool built into DevEco Studio for HarmonyOS app development. Powered by Pangu large model. Supports ArkTS code generation, code completion, bug fixing, UI/page generation, universal card generation, and unit test generation. Nine core capabilities covering UI layout, logic development, and problem analysis. First AI tool for HarmonyOS native apps.

name: Tongyi Lingma
description: Alibaba Cloud's enterprise-grade AI coding assistant powered by Qwen models. IDE plugin for VS Code and JetBrains. Offers Ask mode (code Q&A, single-file editing) and Agent mode (multi-file collaborative editing). Deep integration with Alibaba Cloud SDKs. Enterprise version ~79/user/month; private deployment available. Strong Chinese language support. One of highest-installed AI coding tools among Chinese developers.

name: Qwen Code
description: Alibaba's open-source terminal coding agent from the Qwen team. Repository editing, shell tools, MCP support, and headless operation. Already in main dataset.

name: Qoder CN
description: Alibaba's intelligent agent programming platform for real-world software development. Features NEXT, Agentic Chat, Quest, and RepoWiki. Supports assisted, collaborative, and autonomous programming. Available as IDE, JetBrains/VS Code plugins, and CLI.

name: Iflow-Cli
description: Alibaba's free terminal-based development tool. Supports all top Chinese coding models including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM4.6, and Kimi2. Can be used as a VSCode plugin.

name: ERNIE Comate
description: Baidu's AI coding assistant powered by ERNIE (Wenxin) large model. Supports 100+ languages and 10+ IDEs. 92% project understanding accuracy in benchmarks. Features multimodal input (screenshot-to-code), multi-Agent collaboration, F2C (design-to-code). Best in Python, C++, and Java. Enterprise version ~799/person/year. Free personal standard version.

name: Trae
description: ByteDance's AI-native IDE (first domestic AI-native IDE). Built on VS Code architecture. Free alternative to Cursor. Three modes: Chat, Builder, and SOLO (autonomous analysis/coding/testing/deployment). Supports Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek R1/V3, GPT-4o. Monthly active users exceeded 1.6 million. Free with monthly limits; Pro plan ~$3-10/month.

name: Trae Agent
description: ByteDance's open-source software engineering agent for repository analysis, code editing, command execution, and benchmark tasks. Already in main dataset.

name: MarsCode
description: ByteDance's lightweight AI coding plugin (also known as Douba MarsCode). Available as VS Code plugin and browser-based Cloud IDE. Powered by Doubao model. Supports 100+ languages. Code completion, project Q&A, unit test generation, bug fixing. Free to use. Being integrated into Trae desktop IDE.

name: Doubao-Seed-Code
description: ByteDance's programming model focusing on long context and visual understanding (image/design draft to code). One of the five top domestic tools in 2026 Q2 benchmarks. Requires pairing with an IDE or CLI for complete workflow.

name: iFlyCode
description: iFlytek's AI coding assistant powered by Spark cognitive large model. Code generation, completion, explanation, bug detection, SQL generation/optimization, unit test writing. Compatible with VS Code and IntelliJ IDEA. Free to use. Already in main dataset.

name: iFLYTEK Spark Coding Plan
description: iFlytek's coding plan featuring unique voice interaction for programming. Write code using voice commands and receive spoken results. Aimed at Chinese code generation and hands-free coding.

name: Spark D2C Agent
description: iFlytek's AI agent enabling efficient product design from concept to implementation (design-to-code).

name: JoyCode
description: JD.com's AI-integrated development environment. Deeply integrates with JD Cloud's JoyAgent ecosystem. Supports custom rules, MCP protocol extensions, and multi-source AI resource references. Natural language programming where AI auto-generates code from descriptions.

name: JoyCoder
description: JD Cloud's AI coding assistant based on LLMs. Compatible with JetBrains, VSCode, and other IDEs. Code prediction/completion, comment-to-code, unit test generation, API documentation, AI code review, code explanation, error analysis, UI sketch-to-frontend code, security vulnerability identification and auto-fix, intelligent Q&A. Multi-model switching.

name: JoyCode-Agent
description: JD's open-source intelligent coding agent. 74.6% pass rate on SWE-Bench Verified (Top 3 globally). Functions as JoyCode's built-in agent: autonomously analyzes requirements, plans tasks, reads project directories, writes code, and generates terminal commands.

name: JoyAgent 3.0
description: JD Cloud's intelligent agent platform. Works with JoyCode 2.0 as part of the Agent+Coding AI development paradigm. Enables closed-loop where Agent simplifies code and code feeds back into Agent.

name: CatPaw
description: Meituan's self-developed AI IDE with Agent+human collaboration concept. Code completion, quick Q&A code generation, built-in preview/debugging, project-level analysis. Supports Python, Java, JavaScript. Integrates Meituan's LongCat large model with multi-model mixed calling. Competitor to Cursor; primarily used internally.

name: NoCode
description: Meituan's first AI Coding Agent product (launched June 2026). Branded as Vibe Coding. Zero-code development tool for small/medium merchants to quickly build websites. AI intelligent programming, visual editing, one-click Edge Runtime publishing, SEO optimization, and data analysis.

name: MiMo Code
description: Xiaomi's open-source terminal coding agent with interactive and headless modes, repository tools, skills, hooks, and worktree support. MIT license. Already in main dataset.

name: CodeGeeX
description: Open-source multilingual AI coding assistant by Tsinghua THUDM Lab and Zhipu AI. 13B parameter model pretrained on 850B+ tokens across 20+ programming languages. Code generation, completion, translation, commenting, bug fixing, repo-level Q&A, unit test generation. Free, supports offline/local private deployment (6G VRAM). Ensures code privacy.

name: CodeGeeX4
description: Latest version of CodeGeeX open-source coding assistant by Zhipu AI. Updated model and capabilities.

name: GLM Coding Plan
description: Zhipu AI's coding subscription offering. Mentioned in subscription comparison alongside Claude Max, ChatGPT Pro, and Cursor. Integrable with Claude Code/Codex via GLM models.

name: Kimi Code CLI
description: Moonshot AI's open-source terminal coding agent. Repository tools, skills, MCP support, and IDE connectivity through ACP. Powered by Kimi K3 with up to 1M context. Already in main dataset.

name: DeepSeek Coder
description: DeepSeek's open-source code model API with open weights for local deployment. Lowest-cost API option. DeepSeek-V4-Flash at $0.14/M input tokens (1M context); Coder 7B deployable locally. Best for custom AI coding pipelines, batch processing, and on-premises compliance scenarios.

name: MonkeyCode
description: AI coding platform for teams by Chaitin. Chinese-optimized, strong code understanding, team collaboration management. Already in main dataset.

name: DeerFlow
description: ByteDance's open-source long-horizon super-agent harness orchestrating sub-agents, skills, memory, and sandboxes. Terminal workbench (TUI) plus web UI. Already in main dataset.

name: ChatDev
description: OpenBMB/Tsinghua's virtual software company driven by intelligent agents assuming roles (CEO, CTO, programmer, reviewer, tester). Collaborative software development. Already in main dataset.

name: AgentScope
description: Alibaba/ModelScope's open-source framework for building LLM-empowered multi-agent applications. Already in main dataset.

name: OpenCodeReview
description: Alibaba's open-source AI code review CLI (ocr) that reviews working-tree, branch, or commit diffs. Delegation mode to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode. Already in main dataset.

name: Qwen-Agent
description: Alibaba's open-source agent framework built upon Qwen>=3.0. Function Calling, MCP, Code Interpreter, RAG, Chrome extension. Already in main dataset.

name: PaiAgent
description: Lightweight AI workflow orchestration system similar to Dify/n8n, built using Vibe Coding with Qoder+CLI. SpringAI, LangGraph4J, SSE, MinIO, DAG engine. Already in main dataset.

name: loushang
description: AI-native agent harness for coding workflows. Multi-model LLM orchestration, stateful sessions, tool governance, traceable delivery. Supports GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax. Already in main dataset.
